description: Dept. of Government- Eastern Province Declared Vice Chairman of Lahugala Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically announces the election and declaration of a Vice Chairman for a local authority (Lahugala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes and results at the local government level, including the declaration of an elected official, which falls squarely under Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
